{"description":"The shared server — not the session, and not a harness hook — keeps the working-tree export current after every graph change, coalescing bursts through a debounce, and sets the export's prev_content_hash from the export as committed on the default branch when a git repository is present.

⭐ HALF BUILT, 2026-09-12 (epoch:the-export-chains-from-main). THE LINEAGE HALF IS DONE: a written export chains from its own path at the merge-base with the default branch, so every export on a branch chains from the same committed ancestor and a squash-merge lands one hop. The receipt carries `chained_from`, and outside git the previous on-disk chaining stands with a stated reason. THE WRITE-THROUGH HALF IS NOT BUILT: the server still exports only when asked.

WHY THE SERVER OWNS THE REMAINING HALF: the session is the thing that might not come back. The Stop hook fires once and exists in one harness, so a consumer of reflow2 in any other client would never see it.

WHY THE LINEAGE MOVED FIRST: continuous writing collides with one-export-per-PR only while the chain is built from the FILE on disk, so the anchor had to move before the writing could become automatic. It is also useful on its own — `dec:export-once-per-pr`'s "and it must be LAST" clause is now automatic rather than remembered.

OF THE FOUR QUESTIONS THE INCREMENT CARRIED, TWO ARE ANSWERED: the git query is the MERGE-BASE with the default branch, not the tip, because on a long-lived branch the tip moves underneath you and the export would claim descent from work it never contained; and the no-git fallback is today's on-disk chaining, reported rather than silent, so reflow2 assumes nothing about git. TWO REMAIN OPEN and belong to the write-through half: the debounce interval, and what happens when the working tree holds a hand edit of the export.

AFFORDABILITY, MEASURED: a full export of the largest design in existence is 265 ms (2026-08-25, down from 1,168 ms), and the debounce means a burst of ten changes costs one export.","name":"The server writes the design export through to the working tree on every change, debounced, and chains its lineage from what is committed on main","provenance":"authored","status":"in_progress","tier":"operational"}
